name: Lieutenant Orrin
summary: At Stormwind's gates, Lieutenant Orrin calls for scouts as the Scourge stirs beyond the city. From the Valley of Heroes, he directs recruits to investigate undead threats before they reach the capital.

sections.title: A Sentinel at the Gates
sections.body: Lieutenant Orrin watches the road from the Valley of Heroes. The Argent Dawn holds the front lines in the ruined north, yet it also guards strongholds farther south, including Stormwind City. When necromantic magic stirs beyond the capital, Orrin raises the alarm and rallies adventurers before the undead can threaten the people within.

sections.title: Eyes on the Unliving
sections.body: Lieutenant Orrin links the Argent Dawn with volunteers in the southern kingdom. When signs of the Scourge appear beyond Stormwind's gates, he sends scouts to gather intelligence and secure hazardous artifacts. Among the objects they recover are cracked necrotic crystals, which help the order understand and repel the undead threat.

aliases: who is the argent dawn officer
faq.answer: Lieutenant Orrin is a human officer of the Argent Dawn, stationed in the Valley of Heroes at Stormwind City's entrance. He coordinates defenses and recruits scouts when the Scourge threatens the surrounding lands.

faq.q: Why is the Argent Dawn in Stormwind City?
aliases: why is argent dawn in stormwind
what is argent dawn doing here
faq.answer: The Argent Dawn keeps watch in Stormwind because the Scourge threatens lands beyond the Plaguelands. At the capital's gates, its officers watch for necromantic incursions and recruit fighters to stem the undead.

faq.q: What does Lieutenant Orrin ask adventurers to do?
faq.answer: Lieutenant Orrin sends recruits to scout beyond Stormwind City, investigate signs of Scourge activity, and recover artifacts such as cracked necrotic crystals. The order studies these objects to understand the unholy magic behind the incursions.

angles.text: For Alliance champions returning to Stormwind, Lieutenant Orrin's watch shows that the southern heartlands face danger from the Lich King's reach.
As a paladin, you join the Argent Dawn's effort to purge necromancy wherever it festers.
